content.question: Match different common supervised learning algorithms with their descriptions

answer.K-Nearest Neighbours: It assigns the majority class among the N nearest neighbours of the new point.
answer.Support Vector Machine: Primary objest is to find the hyperplane that separates the classes while maximizing the margin between them.
answer.Linear Discriminant Analysis: It assumes that every class follows a multivariate normal distribution and all classes share a common covariance matrix.
answer.Quadratic Discriminant Analysis: It assumes that every class follows a multivariate normal distribution and each classe has its own covariance matrix.
answer.Naive Bayes: Core assumption is that all features are conditionally independent given the class label.
